scope: PDF source compilation, export, source identity, and page layout only. Lean execution and independent semantic review are recorded separately.

artifact_marker.timing: Immediately before the first authoring command for this new report.

native_compilation.message: The final source compiled successfully with the desktop editor compiler; the source was opened in its LaTeX editor.

log_normalization: Trailing whitespace was removed from compiler-log lines when saving report.txt; all diagnostic text was retained. The raw main.log is retained outside the submission evidence.

visual_review.scope: All four complete final rendered pages were personally inspected at the output resolution, including mathematical notation, page boundaries, margins, headings, theorem-name layout, and references. This is author visual QA, not an independent semantic review.
visual_review.findings: No clipping, overlap, broken mathematical glyphs, or layout defects were observed. Long theorem names were reformatted before this final successful check.

source_whitespace_check.interpretation: The nonzero no-index comparison status reflects comparison against /dev/null. It emitted no whitespace diagnostics; a direct scan also found no trailing whitespace.

second_visual_review.scope: Personally viewed all four complete final rendered pages and read the entire final LaTeX source. Checked equations, mathematical glyphs, margins, page boundaries, theorem-name formatting, source interpretation and report/proof correspondence. No clipping, overlap or layout defect found. Separate from the independent semantic review.
